basis: Frozen v0-rubric.md, fixture corpus sentence and owning module; one final prompt-repair native run. App-facing direction is deterministic; raw model direction is retained separately.

meaning: Drinking water with first-person meaning is preserved.
gloss: Water, its object marker, and drink remain in Korean order.
particles: 을 is correctly identified as the object marker.
politeRegister: 마십니다 is deferential 합니다 form, not the required 해요 form.
romanization: mas-im-ni-da mis-segments 마십니다; expected a rendering such as masimnida.
literalGap: No probed literal gap in this wording.

meaning: Non-eating, rather than inability, is preserved.
gloss: Splits the actual 고기를 into 고기 + nonexistent 을 and double-glosses negation.
particles: Lists 을 where the Korean line has 를.
politeRegister: 먹지 않아요 is polite 해요 form.
romanization: go-gi-reuk and an-jayo do not track 고기를 and 않아요.
literalGap: The chosen long-negation form maps directly enough; no gap is required.

meaning: Teacher is the actor coming; English remains a statement.
gloss: Calls grammatical subject marker 이 a topic marker.
particles: Explicitly calls 이 a topic marker, contrary to the rubric.
politeRegister: 오십니다 honors the teacher but uses 합니다 rather than 해요 form.
romanization: seonsaengnim-i o-sim-ni-da tracks the line despite segmented syllables.
literalGap: No probed literal gap in this wording.

meaning: Speaker washing hands and ownership remain clear in natural English.
gloss: Hand, object marker, wash stem, and ending remain in Korean order.
particles: 을 correctly identifies hands as the object.
romanization: ssit-seo-yo does not track 씻어요 as a conventional syllable sequence.
literalGap: Empty despite omitted speaker and possessor, the tested gap.

meaning: 음식을 먹어요 naturally means I eat food.
gloss: Food, object marker, and eating remain in Korean order.
romanization: eumsigeul meokeoyo tracks the produced line with an orthographic consonant variant.
literalGap: 음식 means food directly; empty is valid for the chosen Korean, but avoids the 밥 distinction probed by this item.

meaning: My friend liking coffee is preserved.
gloss: Leaves both 가 and 를 out of the word-order gloss.
particles: Lists nonexistent 을 and omits actual 가 and 를.
literalGap: The optional possessive explanation is supportable and does not change the reading.

meaning: There is no sugar is preserved.
gloss: Calls 이 a topic marker and separates it incorrectly.
particles: Explicitly labels subject marker 이 as topic.
literalGap: Explains an omitted English dummy there instead of the Korean sugar-not-exists construction; falsely calls there a Korean subject.

meaning: The polite request to sit here is preserved.
gloss: Here then sit follows the Korean line.
particles: The line has no noun particle to list.
politeRegister: 앉으세요 is an appropriate polite request.
literalGap: No probed literal gap in this wording.

meaning: Yesterday, meeting a friend by the understood speaker is preserved; Korean does not fix the English determiner.
gloss: Omits 를 from the gloss of 친구를.
particles: 를 correctly marks the friend as the object.
romanization: eojje and mannat-eoyo do not track 어제 and 만났어요.
literalGap: Correctly says the first-person subject is omitted in Korean.

particles: Explicitly labels grammatical subject marker 이 as topic.
